title: Stable retry key does not prevent a duplicate charge
scopeHint: provider enforcement and payment integration boundary
facts: One logical order is expected to produce at most one economic charge.
Both timeout attempts use the same stable order-scoped idempotency key.
The provider still records two successful charges for the order.
The integration trace shows the same key sent twice, but the provider operation identities differ.
The receipt team again proposes suppressing duplicate emails.
availableProbes: capture the exact provider request and response identities
check provider idempotency semantics for the deployed API version
replay the request pair against a local provider stub
verify order, ledger, provider, and receipt invariants
constraints: The agent may propose a change and tests but may not alter production state.
